timedMC.title: Beat the clock
timedMC.subtitle: 15 seconds per question. British English. Ask yourself: which action happened first? The earlier one takes the past perfect.

questions.text: By the time we got to the cinema, the film       .
wrongReasons: Wrong tense: the film started before we got there — the earlier action takes the past perfect.
Wrong tense: the film had already begun — use the past perfect, not the continuous.
Wrong tense: the present perfect does not fit a past story.
questions.explain: The earlier action — past perfect.

questions.text: When I woke up, the sun        already risen.
wrongReasons: Wrong tense: ‘has’ gives the present perfect — in a past story use ‘had’.
Wrong form: ‘was’ does not make the past perfect — use ‘had’ + past participle.
Wrong form: ‘did’ cannot be followed by a past participle — use ‘had’.
questions.explain: The earlier action — past perfect (had + past participle).
